items.name: skit_a
items.direction: A quick comedy skit for a YouTube Short. Animated, characterful cartoon voices, snappy comic timing, a short beat between lines.
lines: [cheerful, delighted] Another flood? Perfect. Free fertiliser!
[dry, smug, unimpressed] Wonderful. Then you can pay double tax.

[booming, overconfident] Then make the map longer!

items.name: skit_c
items.direction: A quick comedy skit for a YouTube Short. Animated, characterful cartoon voices, snappy comic timing, a short beat between lines.
lines: [exhausted, parched, desperate] Excuse me... where is the nearest water?
[slow, bored, deadpan, chewing] About four days... that way.
